name: bge-m3-swedish-superlim
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A full (not LoRA) MNRL fine-tune of BAAI/bge-m3 for Swedish, 568M, shipped at a recommended 768-d Matryoshka cut. The best-evidenced record in this batch: card prints base and this model on the same SuperLim-2 test splits and a 9-task MTEB Scandinavian table, with per-task deltas and the regressions named. Wins SweParaphrase 0.8354 vs 0.8165, SweFAQ 0.6514 vs 0.6055, SwednRetrieval nDCG@10 0.7809 vs 0.7335; LOSES SweRecClassification (0.7647 vs 0.8121) and SwedishSentiment (0.9293 vs 0.9572). Card labels it a retrieval specialist and says so itself. Licence MIT; SweFAQ train split and an unlicensed healthcare Q-A mix were used, so weights are MIT but the data is not. Repo created 2026-08-17.
